title: SWEPatchTest: Evaluating Software Tests Beyond Reproduction
abstract: arXiv:2610.18004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents use generated tests to decide whether a proposed patch satisfies an issue's requirements. A suite that fails on the buggy program and passes after applying the reference patch can still accept an incorrect patch or reject a correct patch. We introduce SWEPATCHTEST, a test-generation benchmark with 619 tasks from SWE-bench Pro, SWE-bench Multilingual, and DeepSWE and 82,579 candidate patches collected from coding-agent trajectories. By replaying each suite on the buggy and patched codebases, \benchmark jointly measures issue reproduction, acceptance of correct patches, and rejection of incorrect patches. Joint Validation Rate (JVR), which requires all three criteria on the same task, exposes failures hidden by single-reference evaluation: the best-performing configuration achieves only 9.21% JVR despite reproducing the reference transition on 59.29% of tasks. translated_title: SWEPatchTest：超越复现的软件测试评估
translated_abstract: 编程智能体使用生成的测试来判断某个提出的补丁是否满足问题的需求。然而，一个在有缺陷的程序上失败、而在应用参考补丁后通过的测试套件，仍然可能接受错误的补丁或拒绝正确的补丁。我们提出了SWEPATCHTEST，这是一个测试生成基准，包含来自SWE-bench Pro、SWE-bench Multilingual和DeepSWE的619个任务，以及从编程智能体轨迹中收集的82,579个候选补丁。通过在每个测试套件上对有缺陷的代码库和打补丁后的代码库进行重放，SWEPatchTest联合衡量问题复现、对正确补丁的接受以及对错误补丁的拒绝三个方面。联合验证率（JVR）要求在同一任务上同时满足全部三项标准，能够揭示被单一参考评估所掩盖的失败：表现最好的配置尽管在59.29%的任务上复现了参考转换，其JVR却仅为9.21%。我们进一步利用验证分数来选择和扩展演示样例……
tldr: 该论文提出SWEPatchTest基准，首次从问题复现、接受正确补丁和拒绝错误补丁三个维度联合评估智能体生成的测试质量，并发现即使最优配置的测试也仅有9.21%能同时满足这三项标准，远低于单一复现评估所显示的59.29%。
en_tdlr: SWEPatchTest introduces a benchmark that jointly evaluates generated test quality beyond issue reproduction—measuring reproduction, acceptance of correct patches, and rejection of incorrect patches—revealing that the best test-generation configuration achieves only 9.21% Joint Validation Rate despite a 59.29% reproduction rate.
